title: Woman with Lace Parasol on Beach Framed Art Print after Vicente Romero 24x20
conditionDescription: Pre-owned, nice displayed condition. Professionally framed (Aaron Brothers). See photos.
descriptionText:
Woman with a Lace Parasol on the Beach - Framed Art Print, after Vicente Romero Redondo

You will receive the exact piece pictured. These are photos of the actual item, not stock images.

Details:
- Image: a woman in a flowing white dress holding a white lace parasol, standing on the shore facing sparkling ocean waves - after the painting by Spanish artist Vicente Romero Redondo (b. 1956)
- Reproduction print with a canvas-texture finish; it is not hand-signed or numbered
- Professionally custom framed by Aaron Brothers (Custom Framing at Michaels) - "White Glove" quality label on the back
- Glossy white frame, approximately 24 x 20 inches
- Paper dust cover backing with hanging wire, ready to hang

Condition: Used / pre-owned, in nice displayed condition. Please review all photos closely; they are the best description of condition.

Local pickup is available if you would rather skip shipping.
